_note: v2.8 plan 69 K12 (no-model lane): a whole-book world-info write never overwrites another page's change to another entry of the same book. The other page is a direct /api/worldinfo/edit from a fresh server copy, so this page's cached copy goes stale exactly as it would behind a second tab. Control: ST's own immediate save of the stale cached copy loses the other page's edit (hazard reproduced). Treatment: the story's file-mode checkpoint world_info write (setWIEntriesState) refuses, writes nothing, evicts the stale copy, and the other page's edit survives; the next write starts from the server copy and lands with the edit kept. Server reads per write are timed. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k12-stale-book.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); const wi = await import('/scripts/world-info.js'); const K = 'SO-V28-69 K12 Book'; if (wi.world_names.includes(K)) throw new Error('fixture book already exists: ' + K); const entry = (uid, comment, key, content) => ({ uid, comment, key, keysecondary: [], content, constant: false, selective: true, disable: false, position: 1, depth: 4, order: 100, probability: 100, useProbability: true }); await wi.createNewWorldInfo(K); await wi.saveWorldInfo(K, { entries: { 0: entry(0, 'Gate entry', ['gate'], 'K gated text'), 1: entry(1, 'Other', ['harbor'], 'other-original'), 2: entry(2, 'Control', ['dock'], 'control-original') } }, true); const server = async (name) => { const r = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name }), cache: 'no-cache' }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('server read failed for ' + name + ': ' + r.status); return r.json(); }; const otherPage = async (uid, text) => { const data = await server(K); data.entries[uid].content = text; const r = await fetch('/api/worldinfo/edit', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: K, data }) }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('other-page write failed: ' + r.status); }; const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const root = (ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator'].settings ??= {}); globalThis.__k12 = { wi, K, server, otherPage, pause, was: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(root.worldInfo ?? {})) }; await globalThis.storyOrchestratorScanGating.requestFile(); return { mode: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().worldInfo.gatingMode };
